CommunityApplications.Profile:
Cartridge is a set of tools for people who self-host a retro game library, by MoveWeight. Everything here is MIT licensed and unofficial — Cartridge is not affiliated with RomM, Gaseous or Retrom.
The pieces are deliberately separate, and only some of them are containers:
- **ROMarr** — the *arr for games. Request a title, ROMarr searches your indexers through Prowlarr, hands the winner to your download client, and files the ROM into RomM, Gaseous or Retrom. This is the app in Community Applications. - **ROM Hub** — ROMarr's plugin layer, a sandboxed host for metadata, artwork, firmware and content sources. A command-line tool, not a container, so it is not listed here. - **Cartridge for Xbox / Roku** and the **Cartridge stream server** — client apps for playing a self-hosted library on a TV.
Support is through GitHub issues on the relevant repository; that is where the maintainers actually read.
